browse.title: Feature Flags
browse.description: Toggle features exposed by installed modules. Overrides persist across restarts.
browse.empty_description: Modules declare flags via register_feature_flags(); install one to see it here.
browse.viewing_system: Viewing system-level flags. Switch scope to override per tenant.
browse.viewing_tenant: Viewing overrides for tenant "{tenant_id}". Tenant overrides beat the system value.

confirm.scope_system: This changes the value for every tenant, immediately.
confirm.scope_tenant: This sets an override for tenant "{tenant_id}" only. Other tenants keep following the system value.
